entity: Small, non-exempt US-listed foreign private issuers and the March 18, 2026 insider (Form 3) filing deadline
what_we_add: A third of small non-exempt foreign issuers filed 13+ days late; China/HK small issuers trail other small foreign issuers by 12 points (p = 0.08 vs non-Israel peers)
why: The usable sources are law-firm and trade explainers on the deadline, the April 1 relief and the exempt countries; none reports how many insiders filed late, so none reaches Known pattern. The SEC FAQ was blocked and not paywalled, so ignored; 9 queries logged. Note: A&O's April 1 relief may excuse some of the '13+ days late' filers.
